title: Applying the Primary Stripes
slide_intent: Use a distinctive graphic selectively so it remains meaningful when people encounter it in different media.
strategic_value: The same stripe artwork on a social post and a poster can connect Burger King communications without making every surface identical.
demonstration: A brief warning against overuse sits beside an angled Instagram phone mockup and a portrait poster, both using the ingredient stripes.
practical_value: Compare a message-bearing social post with a nearly image-only poster when deciding where the primary stripes contribute.

content_islands.name: Application note
content_islands.spec: Place the short instruction to avoid overuse at left.

content_islands.name: Social example
content_islands.spec: Show the angled phone with stripes behind a food-related headline.

content_islands.name: Poster example
content_islands.spec: Place the stripe-only portrait poster beside the phone, with a small mark near its lower edge.

reference_purposes.Application: The page applies the primary stripes to a social post and poster.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The copy asks designers to be thoughtful about applications and avoid overuse; it gives no frequency quota.

ingredient.name: Primary stripes in communications
ingredient.role: Connect selected messages through an ingredient-derived motif.
ingredient.application: Choose applications thoughtfully and avoid overuse.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; social and poster examples illustrate use, not an exhaustive list of permitted media.
